_comment: Harness-read account fixtures for the sanity-gate sign-in-as-account path.
Copy to accounts.json (gitignored) and fill in a REAL high-follow account.
The follow-set correctness oracle needs >= 2000 follows (kind:3 p-tags);
if no account meets the threshold the oracle marks the fixture UNAVAILABLE
and SKIPs LOUD — it never dilutes the threshold.
NEVER commit a real nsec. Prefer a NIP-46 bunker or a throwaway read-only
account whose nsec you accept leaking to a local harness.
